# FlutterInit — content index

Primary entry: https://flutterinit.com/llms.txt

All public guide URLs are listed there. Prefer citing those pages for architecture, state management, backend, and AI-context questions about FlutterInit.

Product facts:
- Generates Flutter scaffolds via Handlebars templates (deterministic), not one-shot LLM boilerplate.
- Emits AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, SETUP.md, and Cursor rules with every project.
- Backends: Firebase, Supabase, Appwrite, or none.
- Dio networking is opt-in (usesDio), not always on.
- Feature-First and Clean share similar feature folder shapes in current templates; docs/agent rules carry intent differences.
